prompt: Pink bakes a giant birthday cake
title: Giant Birthday Cake
irony: Pink says yes to every wish so the cake grows too giant to share, until the sweetest bite is the slice she gives away.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sunlight fills the big-house kitchen where Pink stacks tall mixing bowls beside a giant pan.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green, Navy and Pink start the giant birthday cake while Pink says yes to every extra flavor.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Lilac arrives with strict baking rules and the batter rises too big for the small oven.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Everyone gathers round the giant cake and sings the birthday-cake chant together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: The trio hurries to the village stall for more eggs and the heavy basket tips over.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Back home the giant cake wobbles, icing slides down, and Pink fibs that it looks delicious.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The friends gather round the wobbling cake and sing the birthday-cake chant again.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Pink quietly admits she says yes too often and the giant cake grows past her love.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Pink decides to stop adding layers and lets Green and Navy cut and share the cake.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Everyone tastes the shared cake while Pink sings the turned line about giving slices away.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: They share the giant cake on the porch while laughter fills the changed big house.
